unit_02.step.006.explanation: Roots take in water. The stem holds the plant up. Leaves make food in sunlight. Flowers make seeds.

unit_02.step.011.explanation: The plant in the dark becomes pale and floppy. Plants need light to grow well.

unit_02.fridge.v2.explanation: Carrots and radishes are roots. Celery and sugar cane are stems. Lettuce, mint and parsley are leaves. Cauliflower and broccoli are flowers. Beans, rice, lentils and peas are seeds.

unit_02.bean-trail.v2.explanation: No root shows on day 1. The root grows down on day 4. A shoot grows up on day 7. Green leaves open on day 8.

unit_02.step.028.explanation: Without light, the plant turns pale yellow. Its thin stem becomes floppy, and it is unhealthy.

unit_02.step.033.explanation: Without water, the plant dries out. Its leaves droop and turn brown. It can die.
